result.brief: 提出以目标到达价值为唯一监督的潜空间世界模型表征，并配合一步流策略在噪声空间做进化搜索规划，实现离线目标到达。
result.reason: Trains latent world models whose imagined latents predict goal-reaching value instead of future states, a representation-learning contribution for planning; main contribution is offline goal-conditioned RL planning.
